text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Man, I really want to see my little bro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You really love him lots! I definitely<n>understand
where you're coming from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The video you showed me of him<n>crawling about
the other day was very<n>cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, he's the cutest in the whole<n>universe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since moving to the dorms my chances<n>of seeing
him have gone way down, so I<n>can't help but hug
him tight whenever<n>we do meet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can see why you'd never want to let go<n>too.
Babies are just so squishy, and it<n>feels nice to just
hold them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You got that right! He's gonna get all<n>bulky when
he gets older, so now's my<n>only chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're already assuming he's gonna bulk<n>up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well he is Ryan's little brotherafter all. I can't wait to see what kind ofperson he becomes.
